assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square Foundry VTT fantasy feat icon, Extra Magic Talent. Primary request: original painted game icon conveying gaining a new magical talent. Subject: a single open spellbook with one luminous magical sphere rising above its pages, a subtle second ring of arcane light representing expanded knowledge. Composition: one clear central silhouette, close framing with comfortable edge padding, immediately readable at 64px; no people. Style: polished hand-painted fantasy RPG inventory art, textured brushwork, restrained detail, warm parchment against a dark blue background, concentrated cyan-gold magical light. Constraints: square image, no lettering, no readable runes, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no ornate frame; do not imitate existing wiki art.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square Foundry VTT equipment icon for a Lycanthrope Hunter's Kit. Original painted fantasy inventory art, no characters: a sturdy open brown leather hunter's case with a short silver dagger, small stoppered vials and a sprig of purple wolfsbane neatly arranged inside. The pouch has a simple shoulder strap. Clear central silhouette, close view with edge padding, immediately readable at 64px. Textured painterly style, warm leather and pale silver with small violet accents against a dark navy background, restrained detail, dramatic soft illumination. No labels, letters, logos, watermark or ornate frame. Do not copy existing wiki art.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square Foundry VTT Incanter base-class icon. Original hand-painted fantasy RPG inventory illustration: a contemplative adult scholar-mage shown chest-up in a simple dark blue robe, one hand holding an open parchment spellbook and the other directing a single luminous arcane sphere. Focus on arcane study and flexible magic rather than combat. Painterly textures, warm parchment and gold highlights, cyan magical light against a dark navy background. A strong centered silhouette with generous edge padding readable at small icon size. No lettering, readable runes, logos, watermarks, ornate frame, or copied existing character designs. Match a cohesive polished painted inventory icon collection.

Hand-painted textured fantasy RPG icon, warm leather and wood, cool silver metal, restrained golden highlights on a dark navy background, matching a cohesive painted inventory collection. No lettering, labels, readable runes, logos, watermark, ornate frame or copied existing art.
